:::{#def-mean-function}
#### Mean function

The **mean function** $\mean$ of an outcome $Y$ given a covariate $X$
maps each covariate value $x$ to the mean of $Y$ given $X = x$:

$$
\mean(x) \eqdef \E{Y \mid X = x}.
$$ {#eq-mean-function}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

The pds notes' [conditional expectation function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cond-expectation-function),
written here as a function of $x$.
:::
